reviewItem.question: Does "Cilium could previously be run in a configuration where the Etcd instances that distribute Cilium state between nodes would be managed in pod network by Cilium…" mean a change to protocol-behavior:cilium|name=cilium-managed-etcd-in-pod-network (deprecated)?

proposed.statement: Running Cilium's Etcd instances (that distribute state between nodes) in the pod network managed by Cilium itself is deprecated; alternatives are in the k8s_install_etcd guide.
